subject: Ensino Religioso
description_pt: Analisar doutrinas das diferentes tradições religiosas e suas concepções de mundo, vida e morte.

components.description_pt: Identificar doutrinas centrais de tradições religiosas distintas sobre natureza do mundo
components.description_en: Identify core doctrines of distinct religious traditions regarding the nature of the world

components.description_pt: Comparar concepções de vida e morte em diferentes tradições religiosas
components.description_en: Compare conceptions of life and death across different religious traditions

components.description_pt: Analisar como diferenças doutrinais entre religiões moldam suas visões de mundo
components.description_en: Analyze how doctrinal differences among religions shape their worldviews
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how differences in authors' points of view affect their treatment of the same historical subject

cc_matches.description: Compare the point of view of two or more authors for how they treat the same or similar topics, including which details they include and emphasize in their respective accounts.
